{
  "dataset_name": "anon_dataset_08",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "continuous_core_z_projection",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted, clipped z-score projection of six stable continuous columns using training-fold means and standard deviations.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a single smooth axis from stable continuous columns, giving the linear_svm a well-scaled direction rather than many partially redundant raw inputs.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.20 * np.clip((x001 - 4.776870253164557) / 0.5484442083033194, -3.0, 3.0) + 0.18 * np.clip((x013 - 3.430072784810126) / 0.5570211496505924, -3.0, 3.0) + 0.18 * np.clip((x015 - 9.926072784810128) / 0.9416685859234286, -3.0, 3.0) + 0.16 * np.clip((x027 - 2.215224683544304) / 0.22989479602379848, -3.0, 3.0) + 0.14 * np.clip((x036 - 3.793189873417722) / 0.6994267422293443, -3.0, 3.0) + 0.14 * np.clip((x039 - 8.485860759493672) / 1.0072770097063506, -3.0, 3.0), -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "signed_offset_projection",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted clipped projection for signed near-zero and near-one columns, preserving direction and bounding outlier influence.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures signed departures in tightly scaled measurements, useful for a linear margin sensitive to offset direction.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.35 * np.clip((x012 + 0.19317088607594934) / 0.7583518245414135, -3.0, 3.0) + 0.35 * np.clip((x028 + 0.00595253164556962) / 0.1665658372131037, -3.0, 3.0) + 0.15 * np.clip((x017 - 1.0101518987341773) / 0.044033097047962856, -3.0, 3.0) + 0.15 * np.clip((x018 - 1.1312943037974685) / 0.02889798894424369, -3.0, 3.0), -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_count_activity_burden",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-normalized total burden over high-variance count-like columns.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "count_burden",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses skewed count magnitude into a monotone bounded score that is easier for a linear margin to weight.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(x003 + x005 + x006 + x007 + x009 + x010 + x011 + x016 + x023 + x032 + x033 + x034 + x035 + x038 + x041) / np.log1p(199.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "nonzero_discrete_fraction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of discrete and count-like columns with nonzero values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "sparsity_profile",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Represents how broadly the sparse discrete columns are activated, complementing total magnitude with coverage.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(x003 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x004 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x005 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x006 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x007 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x009 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x010 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x011 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x016 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x019 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x020 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x021 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x023 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x024 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x025 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x026 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x029 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x032 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x033 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x034 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x035 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x038 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x040 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x041 > 0, 1.0, 0.0)) / 24.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "rare_marker_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Soft normalized intensity across rare low-frequency marker columns.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "rare_marker_profile",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Summarizes unusual row configurations smoothly instead of relying on many sparse indicator weights.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((x004 / 3.0 + x019 + x020 / 2.0 + x021 / 3.0 + x024 + x025 + x026 / 3.0 + x029 + x040 / 3.0) / 9.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "upper_tail_severity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average clipped exceedance above one training-fold standard deviation for selected high-tail continuous columns.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "tail_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Turns multiple high-end excursions into a continuous severity feature with clipped influence from single extremes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.maximum(np.clip((x002 - 3.0600427215189874) / 0.8117726883249491, -3.0, 3.0) - 1.0, 0.0) + np.maximum(np.clip((x008 - 37.062658227848104) / 9.299336332500504, -3.0, 3.0) - 1.0, 0.0) + np.maximum(np.clip((x014 - 1.3344050632911393) / 0.8124814353320162, -3.0, 3.0) - 1.0, 0.0) + np.maximum(np.clip((x030 - 8.652316455696203) / 11.968861908073771, -3.0, 3.0) - 1.0, 0.0) + np.maximum(np.clip((x031 - 2.642208860759494) / 2.2649071852159874, -3.0, 3.0) - 1.0, 0.0) + np.maximum(np.clip((x036 - 3.793189873417722) / 0.6994267422293443, -3.0, 3.0) - 1.0, 0.0) + np.maximum(np.clip((x037 - 2.527870253164557) / 0.5972420678386097, -3.0, 3.0) - 1.0, 0.0)) / 14.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "lower_tail_deficit",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average clipped deficit beyond one training-fold standard deviation below the mean for selected continuous columns.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "tail_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures joint low-end deficits across stable continuous columns, adding a separate smooth direction for below-usual profiles.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.maximum(-1.0 - np.clip((x001 - 4.776870253164557) / 0.5484442083033194, -3.0, 3.0), 0.0) + np.maximum(-1.0 - np.clip((x008 - 37.062658227848104) / 9.299336332500504, -3.0, 3.0), 0.0) + np.maximum(-1.0 - np.clip((x013 - 3.430072784810126) / 0.5570211496505924, -3.0, 3.0), 0.0) + np.maximum(-1.0 - np.clip((x015 - 9.926072784810128) / 0.9416685859234286, -3.0, 3.0), 0.0) + np.maximum(-1.0 - np.clip((x022 - 1.2384050632911392) / 0.09362938911478945, -3.0, 3.0), 0.0) + np.maximum(-1.0 - np.clip((x027 - 2.215224683544304) / 0.22989479602379848, -3.0, 3.0), 0.0) + np.maximum(-1.0 - np.clip((x039 - 8.485860759493672) / 1.0072770097063506, -3.0, 3.0), 0.0)) / 14.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "paired_scale_contrast",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted signed contrasts between paired continuous columns with scale-safe denominators.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio_contrast",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes relative dominance within natural column pairs using bounded signed contrasts for linear weighting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.22 * ((x001 - x013) / (np.abs(x001) + np.abs(x013) + 0.001)) + 0.22 * ((x015 - x039) / (np.abs(x015) + np.abs(x039) + 0.001)) + 0.20 * ((x036 - x037) / (np.abs(x036) + np.abs(x037) + 0.001)) + 0.18 * ((x017 - x018) / (np.abs(x017) + np.abs(x018) + 0.001)) + 0.18 * ((x022 - x027) / (np.abs(x022) + np.abs(x027) + 0.001)), -1.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "count_to_scale_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between normalized count activity and normalized large-scale numeric magnitude.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio_balance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Separates rows with many count events relative to large-scale numeric magnitude from rows where scale dominates activity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.clip(np.log1p(x003 + x005 + x006 + x007 + x009 + x010 + x011 + x016 + x023 + x032 + x033 + x034 + x035 + x038 + x041) / np.log1p(199.0), 0.0, 1.0) - (0.50 * np.clip(x008 / 60.7, 0.0, 1.0) + 0.30 * np.clip(np.log1p(x030) / np.log1p(71.167), 0.0, 1.0) + 0.20 * np.clip(np.log1p(x031) / np.log1p(17.114), 0.0, 1.0)), -1.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "activity_core_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of normalized count activity with clipped high-core measurements x015 and x039.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a bounded interaction axis between activity burden and high core measurements, exposing a pattern a linear_svm cannot form from raw columns alone.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.clip(np.log1p(x003 + x005 + x006 + x007 + x009 + x010 + x011 + x016 + x023 + x032 + x033 + x034 + x035 + x038 + x041) / np.log1p(199.0), 0.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.clip((x015 - 9.926072784810128) / 2.825005757770286, -1.0, 1.0)) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.clip((x039 - 8.485860759493672) / 3.021831029119052, -1.0, 1.0)), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "profile_coherence_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "0-1 semantic score assigned from the full row pattern and training-fold summary; 0 indicates discordant group behavior, 1 indicates continuous, count-like, and rare-marker groups form a cohesive intensity profile.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_consistency",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a soft coherence axis that can align cross-column consistency with a linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "isolated_spike_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "0-1 semantic severity score based on whether a few columns show extreme values unsupported by related column groups; 0 indicates no isolated spike pattern, 1 indicates strong isolated spikes.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_anomaly_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an anomaly-style severity axis so a linear separator can account for sparse extreme profiles without many separate hard thresholds.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
